overview: A family-owned hotel and restaurant in the fishing village of Mousehole, about two miles from Newlyn harbour. Its 14 rooms mostly look across Mount's Bay, and the dining room, bar, terrace and garden run down towards the sea.
surfTripFit: Mousehole faces Mount's Bay rather than open swell, so it is a food-and-comfort base; Sennen and Praa Sands are a drive away. No surf facilities are mentioned.
gaps: Parking and dog terms not confirmed. In Mousehole, not Praa Sands; no surf beach distance stated.
